_comment: Test fixture for validating duplicate upgrade registration detection under Java 21

testScenarios.name: Duplicate upgrade registration detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that duplicate upgrade registrations are correctly identified and reported

expectedError.message: Duplicate upgrade registration for model 'foo' from '1.1' to '1.2'

serializationTests.name: Error serialization
serializationTests.description: Tests serialization of upgrade errors with Java 21

concurrencyTests.name: Concurrent registration validation
concurrencyTests.description: Tests concurrent validation of upgrade registrations using virtual threads

errorHandlingTests.name: Duplicate registration reporting
errorHandlingTests.description: Tests that duplicate registrations are properly reported with detailed information

errorHandlingTests.name: Pattern matching in error handling
errorHandlingTests.description: Tests that Java 21 pattern matching is used in error handling for improved diagnostics

expectedPatterns: case DuplicateUpgradeRegistrationException dup when (dup.getModel().equals("foo") && dup.getFromVersion().equals("1.1") && dup.getToVersion().equals("1.2"))

errorHandlingTests.name: String template error messages
errorHandlingTests.description: Tests that Java 21 string templates are used for improved error messages

expectedTemplates: String message = STR."Duplicate upgrade registration for model '"{model}"' from '"{fromVersion}"' to '"{toVersion}"'";
